positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how carbon price used in internal carbon pricing scheme is consistent with carbon price used in financial statements
内部碳价格与财务报表价格一致性

Disclosure of whether and how carbon price used in internal carbon pricing scheme is consistent with carbon price used in financial statements。内部碳价格与财务报表价格一致性。每个碳定价机制、期间、适用范围形成独立身份。内部价格不是外部交易价格，价格的货币及每吨CO2e分母必须明确。覆盖比例不能替代被覆盖排放量。
